sentences.text: Allen Ezail Iverson -LRB- born June 7 , 1975 -RRB- is an American professional basketball player who played for 14 seasons in the National Basketball Association -LRB- NBA -RRB- .	basketball	basketball	National Basketball Association	National Basketball Association
He played both the shooting guard and point guard positions .	shooting guard	shooting guard	point guard	point guard
